title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
abstract: arXiv:2610.19065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. However, GR is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval (DR) in online retail candidate generation. We examine their differences on two Amazon Toys datasets under different metrics. GR leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover, while DR leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. With deep analysis, we find that popularity contributes the most to GR's measured value lead. Adding the same static item value to DR in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above GR. Finally, on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with LLM-judged relevance, we show that a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a $47\times$ smaller dense encoder.

translated_title: 重新审视生成式检索与稠密检索：一个静态价值先验即可逆转差距
translated_abstract: 随着语言模型和语义物品标识符（SID）的不断改进，生成式检索（GR）已成为序列推荐中强有力的候选生成方法。然而，在在线零售候选生成场景中，GR 并非稠密检索（DR）的全面更优替代方案。我们在两个 Amazon Toys 数据集上用不同指标检验了二者的差异：在两种方法共同覆盖的用户中，GR 在最佳相关物品价值上领先，而 DR 在精确目标召回率以及排序列表整体的相关价值上领先。通过深入分析，我们发现流行度对 GR 的价值领先贡献最大。在 DR 上仅通过一步重排加入相同的静态物品价值，即可逆转这一领先，同时保持召回率高于 GR。最后，在一个使用 LLM 判定相关性的工业级内部电商数据集上，我们证明了 140 亿参数的 SID-LLM 仍不如比它小 47 倍的稠密编码器。
tldr: 生成式检索相对稠密检索的价值优势主要源于物品流行度这一静态先验，在稠密检索中加入一步静态价值重排即可逆转差距并保持更高召回率，且工业级实验表明 140 亿参数的 SID-LLM 仍不及小 47 倍的稠密编码器。
en_tdlr: Generative retrieval's value lead over dense retrieval mainly stems from a static popularity prior; adding a single static-value reranking step to dense retrieval reverses the gap while keeping recall higher, and at industrial scale a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a 47× smaller dense encoder.
